preregistration_note: These thresholds were written to file before verification/analysis.py was executed on the reconstructed sample. They are not tuned to the observed results. Any later change must be added as a new dated version rather than edited in place.
no_official_price_clause: No official NBA source publishes betting prices. Every price-dependent gate is therefore BLOCKED rather than FAILED, and no return-on-investment figure can be computed from official data alone.

gates.name: Minimum out-of-sample sample
gates.rule: At least 300 graded out-of-sample games (identical to the floor used by the other NBA workspaces in this repository).
gates.rationale: Below 300 games the standard error of a win-rate estimate is larger than the edge being claimed; a 55% strategy needs roughly that many games before a one-sided 5% test can fire.

gates.name: Probabilistic calibration
gates.rule: Brier score strictly better than the naive 0.5-probability baseline, with a paired bootstrap 95% CI on the improvement that excludes zero.
gates.rationale: Probability quality, not hit rate, is what a staking plan consumes.

gates.name: Discrimination vs home baseline
gates.rule: Winner accuracy strictly above the always-pick-the-home-team baseline with a one-sided exact binomial p < 0.05.
gates.rationale: Home advantage is free information; a model that cannot beat it has no signal.

gates.name: Totals skill
gates.rule: Mean absolute error of predicted game total below the naive league-average-total baseline, permutation p < 0.05.
gates.rationale: Totals markets are the cleanest place to detect a genuine pace/efficiency signal.

gates.name: Temporal stability
gates.rule: The claimed metric must be positive in each of at least three disjoint, equal-count time blocks of the walk-forward sample.
gates.rationale: A signal that exists only in one stretch is indistinguishable from variance.

gates.name: Dependence control for combinations
gates.rule: Any parlay or player-prop combination must be priced with a measured dependence adjustment (correlation with 95% CI), not with an independence assumption.
gates.rationale: Legs inside one game are not independent; independent pricing systematically overstates the joint probability of positively correlated legs.

gates.name: Executable price
gates.rule: The strategy must be graded against an official or licensed closing price so that expected value and return can be computed.
gates.rationale: An edge that is never compared to a price cannot be monetised.

gates.name: Multiple-testing control
gates.rule: Every claimed edge must survive Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control at q < 0.05 across all strategies and markets tested in the same run.
gates.rationale: Testing many strategies guarantees some look good by chance.

gates.name: Source and usage compliance
gates.rule: Every input must come from an official source with a per-row URL, and the NBA Stats FAQ restriction on downloading their statistics must be acknowledged on the published site.
gates.rationale: Reproducibility and lawful use are preconditions, not optional extras.

gates.name: Deterministic reproduction
gates.rule: One documented command must regenerate the transcription, the model output and every published page. The transcription must be byte-identical on rebuild; the statistical output must reproduce the same values within published tolerances, and the site checks and publication invariants must pass.
gates.rationale: A number nobody can rebuild is a rumour.
